name: Back-office consolidation
summary: In The Open Group's ArchiSurance case study the company was formed by merging three insurers, one per product line. Each kept its own back office and systems. This illustrative programme moves home, travel, car and legal aid onto shared customer, policy and claims components, following the Component and One Stop principles in the Archi model.
view_sub: What the consolidation means for the architecture: programme principles, the addressable run cost, contract exposure and the key platform decisions.

milestones.label: Car policies migrated to the Home & Away platform
Legacy car and legal aid systems retired

phase_notes.Phase 1 (2026-27): Plus: programme governance, data migration approach, product mapping between lines.

decisions.title: Single policy administration platform
decisions.options: Extend the Home & Away platform to all lines · Buy a new policy administration package · Keep separate systems behind a shared customer layer
decisions.hypothesis: Extend Home & Away. It already holds the shared customer and policy components named in the Archi model. Widest blast radius in the estate, and it runs on the mainframe.

decisions.title: One CRM and contact centre platform
decisions.options: Replace both with one SaaS platform · Keep the CRM, replace the call centre application
decisions.hypothesis: Replace the agent desktop first, then decide on the CRM once the single customer view is live.

decisions.title: Mainframe future
decisions.options: Retain and modernise · Rehost on standard platforms · Retire together with a policy administration replacement
decisions.hypothesis: Retain through the consolidation; decide after the policy platform decision, because it sets most of the mainframe workload.

decisions.title: Claims platform
decisions.options: Claims workflow on top of Claim Data Management · Full claims system replacement
decisions.hypothesis: Grow the claims workflow and shrink Claim Data Management to a record store.

decisions.title: Shared document processing
decisions.options: Keep the Document Processing SSC tools · Move to a digital mailroom service
decisions.hypothesis: Digital mailroom; the SSC already serves all lines.

commitments.stated: Customers have one point of contact for all products and claims.
commitments.implication: Shared customer data and one contact centre platform; product-line systems must feed the CRM.

commitments.stated: Product lines share application components instead of running their own.
commitments.implication: Car and legal aid move to the shared policy and customer components; legacy systems retire.

commitments.stated: Applications run on a small set of standard platforms.
commitments.implication: Mainframe and Unix farm consolidate; new workloads go to cloud.

commitments.stated: Fewer products and vendors, licensed for real use.
commitments.implication: Retiring the legacy systems removes two vendors and their support contracts.

commitments_title: Programme principles and what they mean for the architecture
commitments_sub: Principles from the Archi sample model, paraphrased. Implications are EA analysis.
synergy_note: Set an indicative saving per lens to size the run-cost opportunity. Illustrative: excludes one-off migration cost and dual running.
